surprises.description: Q3 revenue was $218 million, above both the $213.2 million consensus and the company’s $216 million guidance ceiling. The beat was modest relative to the preview’s $216 million functional bar.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Q3 FY2026 revenue reached a record $218 million” and “exceed[ed] the top end of guidance.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: “Q3'26 Consensus” total revenue was “213.2”; the guide was “210 – 216”; the preview’s “functional bar” was “~$216M.”

surprises.description: Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $0.84 topped the $0.79 consensus and exceeded the $0.82 high end of guidance. It also beat the preview’s estimated $0.82 functional bar, though by only $0.02.
surprises.expectation_evidence: Consensus was “$0.79”; guidance was “$0.75 – $0.82”; the preview’s “functional bar” was “~$0.82.”

surprises.description: Q4 revenue guidance of $227–233 million has a $230 million midpoint, at the top of the preview’s expected $222–230 million range, and its high end is above that range. This is a somewhat stronger outlook than the preview’s central expectation.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Q4 guidance calls for revenue of $227-233 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview’s Q4 bar was “~$222–230M revenue.”

surprises.description: The company reported record operating cash flow of $102 million, well above the preview’s expectation of a rebound toward $80 million or more.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Record cash flow from operations of $102 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The preview said “a rebound toward $80M+ would defuse point 4.”

surprises.description: The company disclosed a $100 million accelerated repurchase, $135 million of total buybacks in the quarter, and a plan to return 40–50% of free cash flow over time. The preview had highlighted insider selling but did not anticipate this shareholder-return commitment; the repurchases also reduced cash and securities by $48 million from Q2.
surprises.fact_evidence: “The company completed a $100 million accelerated share repurchase and plans to return 40-50% of free cash flow to shareholders over time”; buybacks were “$135 million,” reducing cash and marketable securities “down $48 million from Q2.”

surprises.description: The company supplied full-year 2026 growth expectations—revenue up about 18%, product revenue up about 24%, and non-GAAP EPS up about 24%—which the preview had not quantified. There is no directly comparable full-year estimate in the preview, so the degree of outperformance versus expectations is unclear.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Full-year 2026 revenue is expected to grow ~18% over 2025, with product revenue up ~24% and non-GAAP EPS up ~24%.”
